properties.statement:
MEASURED ON reflow2's OWN GRAPH, 2026-08-19, while parking two field reports under `dec:a-dated-field-report-is-registered-and-parked` — NEW EVIDENCE FOR INSTANCE (b) OF THIS REQUIREMENT, which said `disconnected_community` cannot see a ruling.

**`parks` DID ITS JOB EXACTLY.** Both Artifacts left the `orphan_node` list and appeared in `detect_defects`'s `swept.parked` — visible and counted, not silenced. That half works as advertised.

⚠️ **AND THE DEFECT COUNT WENT UP ANYWAY, 36 → 37.** The two parked Artifacts plus the ruling Decision that parks them immediately formed a 3-node `unthreaded_cluster` (`heal:ad4ec5186566ff68`, warning): *"3 nodes form a cluster with no traceability edge to the main body."* Parking a genre CREATES an island by construction — the ruling and the things it parks are joined only to each other, which is precisely what a ruling over an unattached genre looks like.

**SO ONE DETECTOR READS THE RULING AND THE OTHER DOES NOT.** `orphan_node` honours `ruling: parks`; `unthreaded_cluster` never sees it. Doing the right thing still degraded the instrument, just through a different rule — the same direction this requirement exists to reverse.

**WHAT MADE IT GO AWAY HERE, and why a user may not have it:** a second, ORDINARY `GOVERNED_BY` edge from the ruling Decision to this Requirement, drawn because it is true — the ruling exists because of this requirement and `parks` is its answer. Defects returned to 36, so the final cost of registering two documents was ZERO. But that edge existed to be drawn only because the ruling happened to have a parent already in the main body. A user whose standing ruling has no such parent — the ordinary case for a house rule about incident reports or customer complaints — gets a permanent `unthreaded_cluster` warning for doing exactly what the design told them to do, and the only ways out are to draw an edge nobody means or to stop parking.

📌 SCOPE OF THE CLAIM: measured once, on one graph, with one ruling over two artifacts. Whether `unthreaded_cluster` SHOULD honour a `parks` ruling, or whether a parked island is genuinely worth reporting, is a judgement nobody has been asked for — and this fact does not settle it. Not established: whether `disconnected_community` (the sibling rule named in instance (b)) behaves the same way, which was not exercised.
